<subject>Re: (No Subject)</subject>
<body>
Gregor,

The children enjoy the usual toys and games. Jonas is fond of superhero figures, while Lena really appreciates anything related to art. Books would also be a great choice.

We will be celebrating Christmas in Hamburg with Anna’s sister. We plan to visit Bremen for New Year's.

How long will you be staying? What are your plans? Please write and let me know how things are going for you in the big city.

Matthias
</body>
